section: Opening of I.1 and nature of language

decisions.question: Printed hierarchy and presentation
decisions.resolution: Retain the checked Arabic1, not the RomanI introduced by Codex. Darstellung is presentation, as in the earlier heading; do not silently change the level.

decisions.question: Grundzüge and general type
decisions.resolution: Use Outlines consistently with the work’s title. Typus concerns the general process pattern, not a morphological language class.

decisions.question: Scope of the printed heading
decisions.resolution: Keep language in general, not a claim about a single language.

decisions.question: Interaction without added constituent ontology
decisions.resolution: Full interaction preserves Zusammenwirken without adding the base candidate’s explicit parts where the German does not name them.

decisions.question: Provisional organizational deduction
decisions.resolution: Keep might follow, the chapter-wide material and at least in outline; do not turn the proposal into an established classification.

decisions.question: Thought and feeling capacity
decisions.resolution: Render the coordinated Denk- und Empfindungsvermögen without requiring two separately enumerated faculties.

decisions.question: Historical evaluation
decisions.resolution: Mutilated retains verstümmelt rather than silently softening the author’s judgment. The focused sign-language note supplies the modern qualification.

decisions.question: Bodily sensation and expressive feeling
decisions.resolution: Sensation fits the animal-cry context; feeling remains appropriate in the wider thought/feeling contrast. No single English equivalent is imposed on every Empfindung.

decisions.question: Wesen in context
decisions.resolution: Nature states the character of the thinking process, avoiding a new doctrine introduced by stylistic variation.

decisions.question: Testing intelligibility
decisions.resolution: Keep the experimental testing claim without implying a specific chronological experiment before all self-understanding.

decisions.question: Qualification of the singing creature
decisions.resolution: Retain the active qualification only one that joins ideas to its tones, within the singing comparison, alongside the qualified historical label and richness assertion.

decisions.question: Ideenlos is not inattentiveness
decisions.resolution: Ringing devoid of ideas retains the claimed lack of determinate ideational effect, not an ordinary accusation of careless speech; the following allowance for feeling remains.

decisions.question: Audible identity and classification
decisions.resolution: Retain the distinction between increasingly close classification and a language expressing its own singular identity to the ear.

decisions.question: Uncertain printed verb and stock
decisions.resolution: The enlarged print confirms ab-schliesst. Brings much to a close leaves completion/closing-off less narrowly decided; both remain possible. Do not silently emend to a wear-away verb. Stock preserves the grouping metaphor without adding a modern genetic theory.

decisions.question: Representing as an activity
decisions.resolution: The moving mass is of Vorstellen, not merely a collection of already finished representations.

decisions.question: Shared action through influence
decisions.resolution: Keep the compressed causal/shared-action relation; mutual influence is plausible in context but reciprocal direction is not explicit in this phrase.

decisions.question: Common active power in comprehension
decisions.resolution: Power of language keeps Sprachkraft consistent; understanding activates inward receptivity, not a passive store of meanings.

decisions.question: Nested determination and inner life
decisions.resolution: Keep stock, nation, dialect, established sound signs, use and ultimate individuality as nested or successive determinations; inner life is Gemüth, not a new separate cognitive faculty.

decisions.question: Printed supplementation and the kinship genitive
decisions.resolution: Render the printed [zu] as an ordinary English infinitive, recording the supplementation separately. Retain the difficult kinship of human individuality without inventing an independently evidenced metaphysics.

decisions.question: Target of the objection
decisions.resolution: This opposite view refers to the first account in34, not the favoured unity of nature. Keep understanding as active awakening of the hearer’s power of language.

decisions.question: Animal sensation and human linguistic power
decisions.resolution: The activation contrast is not a denial that even the earliest child may already have linguistic power; preserve the parenthetical qualification.

decisions.question: Growth rather than memorized deposits
decisions.resolution: Capacity for language renders Sprachvermögen; the meting-out/deposit/babbling metaphor remains distinct from growth through age and practice.

decisions.question: Direction and strength of the developmental inference
decisions.resolution: The observations are offered as evidence of development rather than mechanical learning, not as conclusions proved by it. Preserve the universal timing assertion and qualify it in a sourced note.

decisions.question: Earliest transfer and continued universal capacity
decisions.resolution: Restore the mother’s-lap image. The German does not specify a precise measured transfer age; the shared human capacity claim and its contrast with diversification remain.

decisions.question: Stock-like disposition
decisions.resolution: Keep the historical claim concerning disposition without translating it into modern genetic terminology.

decisions.question: Predisposition is asserted, not established
decisions.resolution: Use they had originally been destined for another language, but this destiny had been accidentally altered. This takes zu einer andren Sprache with Bestimmung; attachment to verrückt, meaning shifted onto another language, remains possible and is disclosed. No named individual case is supplied.

decisions.question: Weltansicht and standpoint
decisions.resolution: Keep view of the world recoverable rather than replacing it with an unrelated ideological label. It is a standpoint of subjective apprehension.

decisions.question: Three components of the concept
decisions.resolution: Retain impression, subjective reception and the word as speech sound as three contributions. External object clarifies the Gegenstand’s referent here without establishing a global physical-thing/Object ontology.

decisions.question: Both opposed predicates belong to language
decisions.resolution: Language itself is object/independent and subject/dependent in precisely the same respect; do not reduce Subject to an English adjective subjective.

decisions.question: Unexpressed noun in many
decisions.resolution: Many cases leaves open whether generations or languages supply the ellipsis. Remove merely, which could imply that imperceptibility is the only issue everywhere.

decisions.question: Descent, transformation and author note
decisions.resolution: Retain the warning against a language emerging as a separate complete object. The mother language transforms through successive speakers and mixture. Store the original callout after Sprachen and render the full author note separately, not as a raw asterisk in the body.

decisions.question: Distributive language
decisions.resolution: Their languages makes clear the two stocks relate to two primordial languages; it does not turn the singular German into a claim of one shared language.

decisions.question: Appositional sounds
decisions.resolution: Read als Töne as specifying the means, namely sounds, not an added contrast of language using means as sounds.

decisions.question: Author’s methodological self-check
decisions.resolution: Restore the person who risks exaggeration rather than personifying general reasoning as surrendering itself.

decisions.question: Avoid separating individuality and similarity into domains
decisions.resolution: The rejection covers the allocation of individuality solely to sound and similarity solely to the ideal sphere; do not imply the second allocation is independently endorsed.

decisions.question: Not-understanding is within understanding
decisions.resolution: Retain the parallel formulation; failure to understand might suggest total communicative failure, whereas the following argument treats degrees of divergence.

decisions.question: Intellectualitaet without modern IQ
decisions.resolution: Use intellectual life, as in54, for Intellectualitaet; latitude, as in51, for Spielraum. Neither word entails national IQ or a separate measured mechanism.

decisions.question: Dead versus living metaphor
decisions.resolution: Retain dead language as the contrast with the living mind and in55. Here dead is inherited material abstracted from living acts, not necessarily an extinct language.

decisions.question: Orientation towards intellectual life
decisions.resolution: The pronoun refers to national individuality; preserve both whether/which direction and specifically through language. Intellectual life renders the same German family as52 without introducing measured national intelligence.

decisions.question: Retrospective duality and references
decisions.resolution: Keep act/material and natural interconnectedness/freedom distinctions and all printed numeric cross-references, including the overlap at51; no silent correction.

decisions.question: Words and combining into discourse
decisions.resolution: Make Redeverbindung intelligible in English while retaining its stated matter/form relation, not forcing a modern syntactic category on the whole term.

decisions.question: Matter/form is not sounds/rules
decisions.resolution: Preserve both counterexamples and discourse as purpose; word formation also has rules and connected discourse can employ distinctive sounds.

decisions.question: Compressed coordination and hypothetical origin
decisions.resolution: Take intellectual activity as the subject of establishes; articulated sound is the competing grammatical subject. Put the hypothetical beginning with establishment, but disclose the subject and scope alternatives in a local note. Preserve sound becoming articulated sound without a false invariant Ton/Laut equivalence.

decisions.question: Essential nature and preceding logical account
decisions.resolution: Supply nature from the preceding clause, but retain the author’s claim of dependence on vibration; do not reconcile it with21 by a distinction absent from the text.

decisions.question: Two announced aspects
decisions.resolution: Supply second as English coordination for the twofold announcement; the third higher unity is left unexplained, as in the source.

decisions.question: Wesenheit and a hearer
decisions.resolution: Reality, not substantial reality, retains the word’s objective standing through hearing/reply without silently adding material substance.

decisions.question: Pronominal form across languages
decisions.resolution: Retain Humboldt’s structural universality claim without translating it as phonetic identity or genealogical proof. The pronouns are I/you/he, with you representing singular Du.

decisions.question: Inclusive origin parenthesis
decisions.resolution: Read the uneven nicht … sondern auch inclusively as not just … but also, guided by auch. Disclose the supplied scope; retain the modest inner-conviction framing and the unity-of-nature contrast.

decisions.question: Inca identification limit
decisions.resolution: Keep the source’s unspecified language of the Incas and both family/rank associations; do not equate it with a named modern variety without evidence.

decisions.question: Printed pronoun and the overpowered party
decisions.resolution: Retain [they] for print-supplied [sie]; the singular participle describes the one party overpowered physically then mentally, not the newly convergent language.

decisions.question: Unity without one primordial language
decisions.resolution: The unity is mediated sharing among connected languages; retain the explicit denial that this means one original ancestor.

decisions.question: Hypothesis rather than migration fact
decisions.resolution: Preserve the supposition and its consequence: no similarities due to previously formed language under the stipulated absence of contact; do not turn that supposition into established history.

decisions.question: Weltvorstellung differs lexically from Weltansicht
decisions.resolution: Use representation of the world for the changed term without manufacturing a fully separate theory.

decisions.question: Admission about demonstration and repeated because
decisions.resolution: Retain the inability to demonstrate the whole relation empirically in a particular language, followed by the theoretical and practical reasons; preserve the resumed if-clause readably.

decisions.question: Sounds, not silently words
decisions.resolution: The antecedent Laute is retained even though personal dictionary points to word sounds/spoken forms. Record the breadth rather than changing the source noun to words.

decisions.question: Reversed demonstratives and physiological analogy
decisions.resolution: Assign physiological operation to language’s power over humans, dynamic operation to human power over language. Keep freedom’s pronoun open at the level of language/its operative powers; the note explains the analogy.

decisions.question: National aggregate referent
decisions.resolution: Take in demselben as in national influence rather than in the individual; disclose the alternative because it changes the account of aggregation.

decisions.question: Author footnote and printed page brackets
decisions.resolution: Translate the complete note, retain the source-supplied [43.] and attribution to Humboldt; no claim that Klaproth’s cited page has been independently checked.

decisions.question: General type as the comparison point
decisions.resolution: The type is the general pattern of the mental process to which individual descriptions must return; it is not a preassigned morphological class. Now avoids adding an explicit therefore inference.
